batch: yield monitoring preflight, nutrient summary ordering, pollinator habitat capture contract

yield_monitoring.behavior: record --date accepts a valid ISO calendar date and rejects malformed or impossible dates during argument parsing before database acquisition
yield_monitoring.omitted_date: preserved as null and delegated to the existing service default
yield_monitoring.valid_value: passed to the service as datetime.date

nutrient_budget.behavior: v_nutrient_input_summary rows are ordered by input_type, rate_unit, cost_currency_code to make currency and rate-unit groups deterministic

pollinator_habitat.behavior: OpenAPI and runtime enforce the exact create/replay response; location, habitat type, and area match the request; creates return 201 and replays return 200; malformed writer output is sanitized and no-store

rollback: Revert the source and test changes and restore the prior runtime SQL inventory and refactor records; no database rollback is required.
